mintAuthority.summary: DJED is minted and burned permissionlessly against a shared ADA reserve pool by a formally verified autonomous smart-contract bank, with SHEN reserve-coin holders absorbing volatility; minting is gated by the 400%-800% reserve-ratio band rather than a per-user CDP, and COTI/IOG operate the oracle. The Plutus V1 minting policy is fixed, but COTI upgraded the Djed contracts (Djed 1.2, 2024-08) and controls minting updates.

controls.label: Djed autonomous bank contract (reserve mint/burn)
controls.capDescription: DJED mint allowed only while the ADA reserve ratio stays at or above 400% (and within the 400%-800% band); mint price set by oracle ADA/USD.
controls.evidence: Koios script_info observed on 2026-10-01 identifies minting policy 8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61 as plutusV1, created in transaction 46c1db4ab4cae757880056fc4f48abb313bccec71b3f8fff9f10c6749b819ead. The same-session Cardano tip was block 14010981; script_info is a current metadata query, not a historical state call at that block. The official community FAQ distinguishes DJED's 400% lower mint guard from SHEN's 800% upper mint guard, while COTI's 25 August 2023 article says DJED minting is allowed only between 400% and 800%. The deployed-script upper guard remains unresolved; existing cap semantics are retained rather than changed from conflicting prose.

controls.label: COTI operator (oracle, batcher, upgrades)
controls.evidence: COTI controls the ADA/USD oracle price NFT used by the Djed Plutus script. The oracle can only update the price feed. It cannot bypass the immutable reserve-ratio enforcement in the Plutus V1 script. COTI upgraded the Djed contracts in 2024-08 (Djed 1.2, Plutus V2).

review.evidence: Koios API re-verified 2026-07-20: the DJED minting policy (8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61) remains a plutusV1 script created at tx 46c1db4ab4cae757880056fc4f48abb313bccec71b3f8fff9f10c6749b819ead, immutable, with the 400%-800% reserve-ratio band encoded in the script itself. Minting is therefore economically bounded by actual ADA reserves entering the bank contract (economicCapSemantics: bounded); no issuer or governance path can mint beyond the band. COTI's surface spans the oracle, batcher and contract upgrades. COTI upgraded the Djed contracts in 2024-08. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immutable Cardano rules collateral-gate issuance within the reserve band, making reconciliation not applicable and leaving no attestor or prudential supervisor.
